name: Distance protection
summary: Uses measured voltage and current to assess an electrical distance or impedance characteristic.
description: Uses measured voltage and current to assess an electrical distance or impedance characteristic.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the protected line CT and VT circuits. The associated drawing should trace the distance zones and associated breaker trip paths; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the protected line CT and VT circuits.
Trace the distance zones and associated breaker trip paths.
drawingChecklist: Label the protected line CT and VT circuits.
Cross-reference the distance zones and associated breaker trip paths.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Distance protection uses impedance-related criteria; directional overcurrent 67 uses current and directional supervision.
